title: Analysis of a first-order explicit positivity preserving scheme for a class of scalar SDEs
summary: We propose and analyze a first-order numerical scheme for a class of scalar Itô stochastic differential equations with almost surely positive solutions. We construct a new explicit numerical scheme, such that for any choice of the time-step size, the numerical solution is guaranteed to remain almost surely positive. The main result of this article is the first-order strong convergence of the proposed positivity preserving scheme, which is illustrated with numerical experiments and proved rigorously.
